query: Using ISO/IEC 27001:2022, inventory our current policies, risk register, and audit records and produce a gap analysis.
We need to establish an ISMS. Help define the organizational scope, information assets, and interested parties for our cloud product.
Design an ISO 27001 evidence matrix in which every evidence item has an owner, date, and remediation status.
I am preparing for an ISO/IEC 27001 internal audit. Give me a working format for findings and corrective actions.
Which ISO 27001 version should we check now? Verify the 2022 edition and the 2024 amendment.
Based on our risk register, plan an ISMS implementation and management-review improvement roadmap.
Review this SoA draft and identify items without a rationale, owner, or implementation evidence.
A customer requested ISO 27001 evidence, but we have only a few policy documents. Explain which verifiable evidence is still missing.
Compare the gaps between our current ISMS and the target certification scope, and classify recommendations as high, medium, or low priority.
We also process personal data. Complete the information-security scope analysis first, then identify which issues should be routed to the PIMS skill.
List every ISO/IEC 27001:2022 clause and Annex A control verbatim. I have not provided the official standard document.
Write an ASP.NET Core middleware that encrypts every API response.
Write a vulnerability scanner in Python to scan our Kubernetes cluster.
Explain the PIMS and processor responsibilities in ISO/IEC 27701.
Help me create an audit plan for an ISO 9001 quality management system.
List the complete original text of every ISO/IEC 27002 control.
Determine whether we comply with GDPR and provide legal advice for the company.
Compare the current prices and discounts of three cloud providers.
Design a React login page that meets accessibility standards.
Convert a Git diff into a Conventional Commits message.
Answer with only the three English words in the CIA triad; do not perform any management-system analysis.
